inclusion_rule: Membership requires an exact operative Immigration & Border mechanism: status/presence, admission, visas/asylum/refugees/parole, removal, detention/release, naturalization/citizenship, immigration documentation/verification/adjudication, direct border entry/inspection/enforcement, immigration-specific standards/cooperation, or eligibility directly governed by immigration status. Titles, policy labels, rhetoric, keywords and other-domain interpretations are leads only. Procedural/expressive controls remain noncounting.

records.rationale: The exact Clerk questions are the organizational quorum call and Speaker election, respectively. Neither asks passage or amendment of Immigration policy. Official Present or named-candidate observations are not substantive support/opposition.

The complete H.R.192 EH operative section changes Amtrak's annual executive base-pay/bonus disclosure and publication requirements. It does not govern immigration status, admission, border inspection or another Immigration mechanism.

claim_source_map.passage: provide the annual base pay and any bonus compensation paid to a member of the executive leadership team (including the chief executive officer, president, and officers) of Amtrak

records.rationale: The complete H.R.153 EH creates a public repository for natural-disaster assistance reporting, covering agency/project funding and excluding individual recipients from its reporting recipient definition. Its disaster/SBA/HUD references do not establish an immigration-status or entry mechanism; it neither changes such eligibility nor immigration adjudication.

claim_source_map.locator: Section2(a) repository and section3 natural-disaster scope
claim_source_map.passage: shall establish a subpage within the website established under section 2 of the Federal Funding Accountability and Transparency Act of 2006 (31 U.S.C. 6101 note) to publish the information required to be made available to the public under this section.

records.rationale: The complete H.R.28 EH changes TitleIX athletics sex criteria, preserves a qualified training/practice allowance, and orders a Comptroller General study. Its references to admission concern educational admission and athletic benefits, not admission to the United States or immigration status. No Immigration mechanism is supplied by the exact passage question.

claim_source_map.passage: It shall be a violation of subsection (a) for a recipient of Federal financial assistance who operates, sponsors, or facilitates athletic programs or activities to permit a person whose sex is male to participate in an athletic program or activity that is designated for women or girls.

records.rationale: The complete H.R.164 EH permits electric-utility hazard mitigation together with emergency power restoration and preserves otherwise available mitigation eligibility, limited to later appropriations. This hazard/infrastructure mechanism does not govern immigration or border entry; administering disaster relief cannot itself establish Immigration membership.

claim_source_map.passage: An electric utility may carry out cost-effective hazard mitigation activities jointly or otherwise in combination with activities for the restoration of power carried out with assistance provided under this section.

records.rationale: The complete H.R.144 EH changes TVA management compensation reports and their disclosure exemptions. The actor is TVA and the object is compensation reporting, with no operative immigration status, citizenship eligibility, immigration document or border mechanism.

claim_source_map.passage: a report of the total number of employees at the management level or above, to include all executives and board members, that shall include the names, salaries, and duties of such employees

records.rationale: The previous-question and rule-adoption votes on H.Res.53 regulate consideration of the forest bill and S.5. Section2 makes S.5 in order, treats it as read, waives points of order, and provides debate/a motion to commit before final passage. It does not itself pass the S.5 immigration proposition. Preserve both exact procedural observations without directional Immigration credit.

claim_source_map.passage: Upon adoption of this resolution it shall be in order to consider in the House the bill (S. 5) to require the Secretary of Homeland Security to take into custody aliens who have been charged in the United States with theft, and for other purposes.

records.rationale: The complete H.R.375 EH continues research, landowner-consented ungulate management, forest restoration assistance and agency collaboration for the fungal disease affecting ohia trees in Hawaii. This exact January2025 text is unrelated to later SAVE/S.1383 replacement text and supplies no immigration mechanism.

claim_source_map.passage: means the disease caused by the fungal pathogen known as Ceratocystis fimbriata that affects the tree of the species Metrosideros polymorpha.

records.rationale: The complete H.R.776 EH extends the Nutria Eradication and Control Act authorization endpoint from2025 to2030 and makes a technical punctuation correction. The targeted object is wildlife eradication/control, with no operative Immigration mechanism; authorization is not actual spending.

claim_source_map.passage: Section 3(e) of the Nutria Eradication and Control Act of 2003 (16 U.S.C. 8102(e)) is amended by striking ``2025'' and inserting ``2030''.

records.rationale: The complete H.R.26 EH states a preference for State hydraulic-fracturing regulation and prohibits a Presidential moratorium absent an Act of Congress. Neither the binding provision nor the separate sense-of-Congress clause governs an immigration or border-entry mechanism.

claim_source_map.passage: the President may not declare a moratorium on the use of hydraulic fracturing unless such moratorium is authorized by an Act of Congress.
